Could you fix the issue with "PREFER_NINJA" completely?

Could you also tell how to compile libraries with help of Visual Studio 2015 compiler in Visual Studio 2017. How to change the compiler in vcpkg?
Create another triplet for your architecture, platform, complier and use it: `vcpkg install <port>:<triplet>`
Here's the documentation on triplets (including how to specify the compiler): https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/blob/master/docs/users/triplets.md

@fcharlie I think this is most likely due to the codepage issue as well, so I'll close this as a duplicate for now. We can open a new issue if this is still a problem after we fix our codepage handling.
